summary: Completed frontend-only testing of Sereel dark institutional landing page (Vite + React 19 + TS). Verified all data-testids, section presence, mailto CTAs, anchor navigation, SVG fallback for hero, mobile hamburger toggle & mobile use case ledger, capability strip horizontal scroll on mobile, and 0 console errors on both desktop (1920px) and mobile (390px) viewports. All 8 features in the review request pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Header link to '/' (data-testid=header-logo) is a full-page navigation; on a single-route app it triggers a reload. Minor UX nit — consider href='#top' or scrollTo(0,0) via onClick.

HeroRailCore's iframe path is only rendered when SPLINE_HERO_URL is set AND isDesktop AND !reducedMotion — good gating. SPLINE_HERO_URL currently empty per /app/.env so SVG fallback is always used (as expected).
Unused components (WhyEthereun.tsx, MeetTheTeam.tsx, FAQs.tsx, FAQSection.tsx, BeforeFooter.tsx, Button.tsx) remain on disk. Not rendered but adds noise; safe to delete in a cleanup pass.
Footer © year is hardcoded to 2025 while current date is Jan 2026 — recommend using new Date().getFullYear() or bumping to 2026.
test_credentials: N/A — static marketing site, no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: First test run. All required data-testids present and working on desktop + mobile. mailto CTAs verified via href only (not clicked). SVG fallback rendered because VITE_SPLINE_HERO_URL is empty in /app/.env. If Spline URL is later configured, retest that hero-spline-embed iframe appears on desktop and SVG fallback still appears on mobile.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 8 review-request features pass; only minor code-quality notes documented above.
